paragraphs: The AmpliFund address now serves a grants management product presented as Euna Grants, sold to government and public sector organizations. It is built for both sides of the funding relationship, the agencies that seek grants and the ones that award them.

Coverage runs the length of the grant lifecycle, from finding an opportunity through closeout. A research database lists federal, state, municipal, local and foundation funding opportunities. Once money is awarded, the system tracks requirements, deadlines, progress and spend-down in shared reports and dashboards. On the granting side, applications can be designed with scoring criteria down to the individual field and routed automatically for review. Audit trails are described as ready for public records requests.

Customer comments on the page are credited to an economic development specialist in Mariposa County, California. Another is credited to a federal programs specialist at the California Department of Housing and Community Development. Integrations connect the system to an agency ERP for financial information.
